# pangolin_domain_dns_records (Data Source)

Lists the DNS records Pangolin expects (or has verified) for a domain — useful to feed an external DNS-as-code provider that publishes them on your authoritative nameserver.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pull the DNS records Pangolin expects for a domain so another
# provider (Route 53, Infomaniak DNS, etc.) can publish them.
data "pangolin_domain_dns_records" "main" {
  domain_id = "egcq4bwo41tak9o"
}

# Distinct record types in the set.
output "record_types" {
  value = distinct([
    for r in data.pangolin_domain_dns_records.main.records : r.record_type
  ])
}

# Highlight records that have not yet been verified on the authoritative
# nameserver.
output "unverified_records" {
  value = [
    for r in data.pangolin_domain_dns_records.main.records :
    "${r.record_type} ${r.base_domain} -> ${r.value}"
    if !r.verified
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) ID of the Pangolin domain whose DNS records to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) The DNS records associated with the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `base_domain` (String) Name the record applies to (may be a wildcard, e.g. `*.example.com`).
- `domain_id` (String) ID of the domain this record belongs to.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the DNS record.
- `record_type` (String) DNS record type (`A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `TXT`, …).
- `value` (String) Record value (IP, target name, TXT content, etc.).
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether Pangolin has verified that the record is published on the authoritative nameserver.
